{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, indicating systematic undershoot that corrects toward mean over time",
    "When current price is below the 18-day moving average, model forecasts underperform as they lag price momentum",
    "Elevated sentiment (0.67+ or 1.00) correlates with above-average forecast accuracy as optimism captures early price movement",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive precedes model catch-up to true prices by 1-3 days",
    "When price volatility increases (larger daily changes), model forecasts exhibit greater relative error due to lag",
    "Model tends to overcorrect when prices reverse sharply, creating mean-reversion bias in forecasts",
    "Sentiment divergence from prices (model uses clean sentiment ( while prices incorporate it) signals when market fundamentals diverge from model assumptions" ]}
